sources.content: Proposal: soft delete for invoices in Saffronmill. Today, deleting a draft invoice removes its row from the `invoices` table, which breaks audit reports that reference the invoice number. This change adds a nullable `deleted_at` column. A delete request sets `deleted_at` to the current time instead of removing the row. Only invoices in the draft state can be deleted; finalized invoices return error code `INVOICE_FINALIZED`. A nightly job purges soft deleted rows older than 90 days.

Requirements. List endpoints must exclude soft deleted invoices by default. Clients can include them by passing `include_deleted=true`, which requires the `billing:audit` scope. Restoring an invoice clears `deleted_at` and is allowed only within 30 days of deletion. Scenario: restore after the window. Given an invoice deleted 31 days ago, when an admin calls the restore endpoint, then the server returns status 409 and the invoice stays deleted.

claims.text: A Saffronmill delete request sets deleted_at to the current time.
The nightly job purges soft deleted invoice rows older than 60 days.
Passing include_deleted=true requires the billing:audit scope.
Restoring a soft deleted invoice is allowed only within 30 days of deletion.
Restoring an invoice after the restore window returns status 404.
Deleting a finalized invoice returns the error code INVOICE_FINALIZED.
